turns.text: In September 2026 (last month), the Average Order Value (AOV) was **€114.39**, based on total non-cancelled revenue of **€12,582.75** across **110** non-cancelled orders.

args.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE
                                 WHEN LOWER(status) != 'cancelled' THEN amount
                                 ELSE 0
                             END), COUNT(CASE
                                             WHEN LOWER(status) != 'cancelled' THEN 1
                                         END)), 2) AS average_order_value_eur,
       SUM(CASE
               WHEN LOWER(status) != 'cancelled' THEN amount
               ELSE 0
           END) AS total_revenue_eur,
       COUNT(CASE
                 WHEN LOWER(status) != 'cancelled' THEN 1
             END) AS non_cancelled_orders
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-01'
  AND order_date <= '2026-09-30'
